text.text_excerpt: I love PJ's Coffee! I stop at all their locations, cold brew at home, have two tumblers. I'm never in this area but I remembered there was a location here from when I worked in the area years ago. Apparently they do a happy hour from 3-6 on weekdays where up sizing your coffee one up is free. I got a Wedding Cake Velvet Ice and the barista asked if I wanted the base to be vanilla or mocha, which I've never been asked before. There were no chunks of unblended ice in my coffee, which there are usually a few of other places. Both people on staff were friendly and helpful. My only complaint was the pastry selection. Not many muffins or croissants, the glass display case was kinda small so tha...

I decided to check out Pj's on Gen Degaulle when I needed a quiet, delicious study spot. The cafe itself smelled absolutely amazing. They were baking their pastries and the entire place smelled heavenly. Since this was my first time here, I checked to see if they had my usual that I always get at Starbucks-which they did-and they asked if whole milk was okay...So awesome because it is not okay. They assured me they could do skim. Yes Please. I wandered outside with my delicious latte where I found plenty of tables and chairs. It was an ideal place to sit with my cup of heaven and pile of reading.

It all tastes better here! No, really! This is my favorite PJs. It could only be improved with a drive through. The people are friendly, and the food is always fresh and hot. The bagels and cakes are fresh, and the smoothies taste like yogurt. I would comment on the coffee, but I hate coffee, soooo... probably not a good idea!
